messages:
Alex: Heads-up — night change window at 23:00 UTC for tf apply v2. This touches TGW routes + IAM roles. Deploybot: preflight triggered. (automated)
deploybot: preflight result: 1 policy warning (iam-role: broad-perms), 0 plan errors. See plan: https://ci.redwood/plan/6421
Priya: which IAM role? link?
Alex: `modules/iam/roles.tf` — new `service_agent` with `*` on actions in one statement. I raised a quick patch but want a rollback plan in place.
Mike: if we need emergency rollback, we can pin module to `v3.7.2` and reapply. Command:
```
terraform apply -var 'module_iam_version=3.7.2' -target=module.iam
```
Tara: can we do a staged apply? route changes -> canary AZ first? We should hold traffic shift until IAM ok.
Priya: +1 for canary. Also suggest we add a deploybot circuit-breaker tag so cooldown triggers if error rate > 1%.
deploybot: note: queued apply will run at 23:00 UTC in quiet-mode. To abort: `@deploybot cancel 2867001234`
ci-bot: preflight lint failed on one file: `modules/network/route53.tf` line 42 (missing comment). non-blocking.
sre-oncall: if rollback needed, I'll run the network rollback and coordinate BGP with cloud provider. ping me when we start.
Alex: Okay action items: (1) Priya pin IAM module to v3.7.2 in separate branch and open PR, (2) Tara set canary for AZ-1, (3) Mike prepare rollback apply snippet, (4) update release notes link.
Priya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/918 — includes pinned version + test plan. Assigning @sre-oncall for approval.
Tara: canary target created: `canary-targets/az-1` and deploybot updated to use it. :white_check_mark:
Mike: rollback snippet saved in runbook: https://docs.redwood/runbooks/infra-rollback
Alex: I'm leaving the release notes here: https://redwood.app/releases/changeset/6421 — will add a brief summary & rollback steps. Proceeding with scheduled apply unless we see a block.
Priya: LGTM, merging now. :thumbsup:
deploybot: apply started 23:00 UTC. Streaming logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/6421
deploybot: apply completed 23:04 UTC — 0 errors. Post-apply smoke tests in progress.
sre-oncall: smoke tests look good. Monitoring for 20m.
Alex: Great job team. Leaving quiet window until 00:00 UTC. Keep this thread updated with any anomalies. :rocket:
